name: prefix-shrink
description: U8/U9 materialized: the 54-bit prefix is 21% of a 32-byte hash. Every field width is now tunable, so this measures (a) the pure quality COST of a coarser aspect / DC / scale field at an unchanged AC layout, and (b) the NET effect of shrinking the prefix and spending the recovered bits on more AC coefficients at the same 32 bytes. scale_mu companded the scale grid logarithmically, which is what lets a narrower scale field keep its accuracy. b_scale_from_a drops the b-scale field entirely and shares the a code.
